title: polystichum uniseriale
intro: Polystichum uniseriale, commonly known as Japanese holly fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum uniseriale may include its ability to calm the nervous system and support the immune system, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
